hooks.name: Agent stop quality gate
hooks.description: Before work is declared complete, check for accidentally committed focused/skipped tests and unresolved TypeScript errors, and run the unit suite. Reports issues; does not modify or deploy anything.

action.command: echo "== focused/skipped tests =="; grep -rnE "\.(only|skip)\(|fit\(|fdescribe\(|xit\(|xdescribe\(" src e2e 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules | tail -20 || echo "none"; echo "== typecheck =="; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -10 || true; echo "== unit tests =="; npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -8 || true
